systems.country_label: modèle communautaire papier (cahiers villageois, Agents de Déclaration Villageois)
systems.platform: paper: village notebooks and the second copy of the declaration passed to the civil status centre
systems.owner: Direction Nationale de l'État Civil (DNEC), with DGSHP, FENASCOM and the Association des Municipalités du Mali under a memorandum of understanding
systems.tiers: villages, declaration centres and civil status centres, then préfet, governor and DNEC

note: DNEC presentation of 18 July 2026 on civil registration, an application-class system: it describes the community declaration chain as a paper model, and lists full digitalisation of the system and stronger connectivity among its persisting priorities, with a move to a digital model as a prospect. It says nothing of the commune office's own connection, so no fact is taken for the connection sub-indicator.
